scope: Independent code review of the candidate runner and the observed final receipt; no simulator rerun performed by reviewer

resolved_finding.issue: Official verify scores recovered circuit words without comparing optional NPZ angle_words metadata. The earlier runner therefore did not bind its changed_word_count to words loaded by the circuits.
resolved_finding.fix: Complete (1220,75), integer, 8-bit guard; official forward/reverse recovery at every address; explicit equality to candidate NPZ; then unchanged official verify with default 64 shots/address.

confirmed: Comparison baseline requires a prior PASS with 78,080 shots and matching NPZ/verifier SHA256.
Candidate NPZ is copied byte-for-byte and its copied SHA256 is checked.
All 91,500 recovered words are compared with the declared candidate; the preliminary check includes workspace, phase, selection and reverse traversal checks.
Seed 0 is used only for the auxiliary 2-shot word binding. The scoring run retains official default 64-shot hash-derived seeding.
Cost improvement classification uses max(1e-9, 32 ULPs), so a few floating-point ULPs cannot be reported as a gain.
limitations: The preliminary word-binding simulation uses 2 outcomes per address; it is not by itself a proof covering every measurement outcome. The separate final-family exact proof and the full official run remain distinct evidence.
This review does not claim a new public score.
